Rules
  • 1-cost reroll. Slow-roll above 50g at Lvl 5 → 3★ Ziggs + 3★ Kobuko
  • Items pick the carry: non-Tear → Ziggs · Tear → Seraphine, then Teemo
  • Unlock early: 2★ Ziggs + an item → Kobuko · 4 rerolls before the stage 2 carousel → Seraphine

🔓 Unlock path

Most of this comp starts locked. Each unlock is a quest; once done, the unit shows up in your next shop and stays in your pool.
